newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Getronics to buy 65 pct stake in BMG.
newsitem.headline: Getronics to buy 65 pct stake in BMG.

text.p: Electronics firm Getronics NV said on Friday it was in advanced talks to take a 65 percent stake in Business Management Group, an Amsterdam based management consultancy.

"Expectations are justified that these (talks) will lead to Getronics acquiring a 65 percent stake in the business and management consultancy firm Business Management Group BV (BMG) of Amsterdam," Getronics said in a statement.
It said the stake would be taken over from BMG's shareholder-directors, currently sole owners of the company.
BMG would continue to operate as an independent consultancy under the existing management, it added.
BMG's good first-half results were expected to grow further, Getronics said. No financial details of the deal were disclosed.
